claim: The Service Quotas default for Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances is 5, and the quota is adjustable; On-Demand Instance quotas are per AWS account per Region and are managed in vCPUs.

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region; measured in vCPUs
qualifiers.condition: Standard families A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z

evidence.quote: | Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances | 5 | [Yes](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home/services/ec2/quotas/L-1216C47A) |

There are quotas for the number of running On-Demand Instances per AWS account per Region. On-Demand Instance quotas are managed in terms of the *number of virtual central processing units (vCPUs)* that your running On-Demand Instances are using, regardless of the instance type.
